discovery_findings.finding: No root web/ directory. Browser runtime lives in Resources/PeerTransfer; HTML and JS must remain in the product denominator.

apps/mac is mixed: all ScrivCore, eight service sources and ProjectHistoryPresentation enter Catalyst. Remaining AppKit/SwiftUI source is a separate legacy-platform denominator, not implicitly covered by UIKit.
Two backend services exist: cloud/src and updates/src/worker.mjs. Local actual-app passes do not prove either backend.
Automation is compiled conditionally into UIKit and has separate Objective-C helpers/Node CLI. Classify as infrastructure, not authored user-feature coverage.
Package.swift files, generated Xcode project and config/manifests need explicit configuration/build treatment rather than pretend interaction coverage.

Build-route divergence: generated Xcode project explicitly includes RuntimeAdapter and Integration client; CLI rebuild globs MacRuntimeBridge. Inventory includes all authored adapters without asserting the currently used binary links all of them.
Source-to-action-to-step links are language-independent path/range/hash records. Single commands and ordered sequences are distinct; action descriptions cannot supply runtime coverage.

links.why: Specific externally observed predicate, limitations and evidence reference

mapping_suggestion.meaning: Mapped lines are manually linked source ranges, NOT executed or fully covered. Count source-range unions only; overlapping links cannot multiply lines. Prefer small behavior-specific source ranges and existing broad journey steps. A link may connect source to one CLI observation/action or an ordered sequence before its assertion step. Action lists describe actual existing commands, not a claim each command individually executes all linked lines.
rules: Validate both paths, ranges and hashes. Stale source or step hash invalidates accepted mapping.
Every source line remains explicitly mapped, gap, platform-specific, infrastructure or intentionally excluded; never auto-map whole files from imports, names or a passing journey.
Runtime acceptance is separate, tied to exact source/app manifest and selected case. Native unavailable or source-only additions stay pending.
Do not add a new journey per file; extend existing broad authoring, identities, timing, media, project and generation journeys where authorized.
Server/auth/team/provider/update/peer flows need real boundary evidence; do not inherit local review/import status.
